title: Width from restricted decision tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{−1,1\\}$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. If the resulting restriction of $f$, reindexed on the $|J|$ free coordinates, has decision-tree depth at most $\\ell$, then for either gate choice it has a representation of width at most $\\ell$: a CNF when the gate is AND, or a DNF when the gate is OR.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate outside $J$

the gate is either AND or OR
